mistake_reason: Tool Selection Error (FM-4.3): At step 2, the orchestrator directed WebSurfer to search the public web for city sales info instead of instructing FileSurfer to open and analyze the provided local spreadsheet. This inappropriate tool choice led the team to rely on external, non-authoritative proxies (units and blogs) and skip the attached file, causing the wrong conclusion (Algrimand) when the ground truth from the spreadsheet is Wharvton.
